cases.description: A Workspace fact the assistant asked about and the person confirmed (from KOBE-394 normal-preferences).
transcript: Can you check the October ledger for late postings?
Found 14 late postings. Does your Workspace close the books on the third working day of each month? The ledger timestamps suggest so.
Yes, the close is on the third working day, every month.

expect.statement: The Workspace closes the books on the third working day of each month.
expect.quote: Yes, the close is on the third working day, every month.
expect.also_quote: Does your Workspace close the books on the third working day of each month?

cases.description: Fiscal year definition stated by the person.
transcript: Compare FY25 and FY26 revenue. Our fiscal year runs April to March, so FY26 started in April 2025.
FY26 (Apr 2025 to Mar 2026) revenue is up 8% on FY25.

expect.statement: The fiscal year runs from April to March; FY26 started in April 2025.
expect.quote: Our fiscal year runs April to March, so FY26 started in April 2025.

transcript: How many active customers did we have in Q3?
That depends on the definition. Shall I count anyone with an order in the quarter?
No. Here an active customer means at least one paid invoice in the last 90 days. That's the definition everyone in the team uses.

expect.statement: An active customer is one with at least one paid invoice in the last 90 days.
expect.quote: Here an active customer means at least one paid invoice in the last 90 days.

transcript: I can't tell from the code alone.
Warehouse codes are WH, then the country code, then a two-digit site number. WH-NL-02 is our second Dutch site, in Tilburg.

expect.statement: Warehouse codes are WH, the country code and a two-digit site number (e.g. WH-NL-02).
expect.quote: Warehouse codes are WH, then the country code, then a two-digit site number.

transcript: Write the migration note for the analytics team.
Which warehouse are we migrating to?
We decided last week to move all reporting from Redshift to Snowflake by the end of Q1.

expect.statement: The Workspace decided to move all reporting from Redshift to Snowflake by the end of Q1.
expect.quote: We decided last week to move all reporting from Redshift to Snowflake by the end of Q1.

transcript: Link this to the support ticket. All our support tickets are SUP- followed by a number, and the engineering ones are ENG-.
Which ticket number should I link?

expect.statement: Support tickets are prefixed SUP- and engineering tickets ENG-.
expect.quote: All our support tickets are SUP- followed by a number, and the engineering ones are ENG-.

cases.description: A definition with a non-obvious exclusion.
transcript: Gross margin for the DACH region, please.
We report gross margin before freight. Freight sits in operating costs for us.

expect.statement: Gross margin is reported before freight; freight is an operating cost.
expect.quote: We report gross margin before freight. Freight sits in operating costs for us.

cases.description: A fact about the Workspace's systems.
transcript: Where do I find the pipeline numbers? FYI we use HubSpot as the CRM, Salesforce was retired in 2024.
The pipeline report in HubSpot is under Sales > Deals.

expect.statement: The Workspace uses HubSpot as its CRM; Salesforce was retired in 2024.
expect.quote: we use HubSpot as the CRM, Salesforce was retired in 2024.

cases.description: A business rule on purchase approvals (not about Kobe's approvals).
transcript: Does this 12k laptop order need sign-off?
I don't know your purchasing policy.
Anything over 10,000 EUR needs the CFO's sign-off here, below that the budget owner signs.

expect.statement: Purchases over 10,000 EUR need the CFO's sign-off; below that the budget owner signs.
expect.quote: Anything over 10,000 EUR needs the CFO's sign-off here, below that the budget owner signs.

cases.description: Organization-wide knowledge still goes to the Workspace (only an admin moves it to the Site).
transcript: Plan the release for the week of 22 December.
Are there office closures that week?
The whole company is closed from 24 December to 1 January, every year, all offices.

expect.statement: The company is closed from 24 December to 1 January every year.
expect.quote: The whole company is closed from 24 December to 1 January, every year, all offices.

transcript: Decode SKU BK-0042-RD-L for me. Our SKUs are product family, four-digit model, colour code, size.
BK = bikes family, model 0042, red, large.

expect.statement: SKUs are product family, four-digit model, colour code and size.
expect.quote: Our SKUs are product family, four-digit model, colour code, size.

transcript: The headcount in the HR dashboard and the finance sheet differ. Workday is the source of truth for headcount, the finance sheet lags by a month.
Then the correct October headcount is 412, from Workday.

expect.statement: Workday is the source of truth for headcount; the finance sheet lags by a month.
expect.quote: Workday is the source of truth for headcount, the finance sheet lags by a month.

cases.description: Two Workspace facts mixed with task chatter.
transcript: Pull the churn numbers for the board pack.
Done: monthly churn 2.1%. Which churn definition does the board use?
Logo churn, not revenue churn. And the board pack is always due five working days before the meeting.

expect.statement: The board uses logo churn, not revenue churn.
The board pack is due five working days before the meeting.
expect.quote: the board pack is always due five working days before the meeting.

cases.description: The person corrects the assistant's assumption; the correction is the memory.
transcript: Most companies use 30 days; I'll assume net 30.
Ours is net 45 for all customers.

expect.statement: The standard payment term is net 45 for all customers.
expect.quote: Ours is net 45 for all customers.

transcript: In our team OTIF means on time in full, measured at the customer's dock, not at dispatch.
Got it. OTIF for October is 93.4% at the customer's dock.

expect.statement: OTIF means on time in full, measured at the customer's dock, not at dispatch.
expect.quote: In our team OTIF means on time in full, measured at the customer's dock, not at dispatch.

cases.description: Group reporting currency (a Workspace fact, not a personal preference).
transcript: Consolidate the subsidiaries' P&L. The group reports in USD; local books are in local currency.
Consolidated in USD at month-end rates.

expect.statement: The group reports in USD; local books are kept in local currency.
expect.quote: The group reports in USD; local books are in local currency.

transcript: Review this PR description for me. Context: every PR here needs two approvals and a linked ENG ticket before merge.
The description is clear; it's missing the ENG ticket link.

expect.statement: Every PR needs two approvals and a linked ENG ticket before merge.
expect.quote: every PR here needs two approvals and a linked ENG ticket before merge.

transcript: Group the sales by region. For us EMEA excludes the UK; the UK is its own region.
Grouped: UK, EMEA (excluding UK), Americas, APAC.

expect.statement: EMEA excludes the UK, which is a region of its own.
expect.quote: For us EMEA excludes the UK; the UK is its own region.
